correctness.rationale: PASS: Independently enumerated all 2^16 vertex masks of the Hamming-one 4-cube (32 edges), retaining 25,015 valid induced-forest faces; size vector (1,16,120,560,1796,4080,6488,6848,4090,1008,8). Verified full greedy matching with 12,497 pairs and acyclic incidence DAG over 158,256 arrows; ordinary critical cells are one point, 15 dimension-six and 6 dimension-seven. Independently reconstructed signed integral Morse boundary 15×6 exactly matching the displayed matrix; a 6×6 minor has determinant -1, giving ∨9S6, not just mod-2 evidence. For all 384 affine cube automorphisms, recomputed signed invariant-face Lefschetz traces, distribution {-3:20,-1:120,0:128,1:90,3:24,9:2}, trace sum zero and identity/antipode the only kernel elements.
